su.note_on_ufm_displacement: RA: 'UFM 3.5 nodes are connected to four (4) FNM ports on the Q3400 switches' (Fig 7 shows C-UFM 1/2 cabled to Leaf-08-0x). No statement that UFM displaces DGX node ports; 72-node SU maps to 72 downlinks per leaf.
su.mgmt_racks: Fig 3 (1 SU mgmt equipment, 8 racks wide): 4 Q3400 spine, 8 Q3400 leaf, 10 SN2201 OOB, 4 DGX storage leaf, 4 DGX storage spine, 2 inband leaf, 2 inband spine, 2 UFM, 7 Mission Control nodes, 8 storage appliances. Table 7 (8 SU): 144 DGX racks + 48 switch/mgmt racks, 19in standard AC (Legrand NVIDPD13 or equiv)

compute_fabric.tech: NVIDIA Quantum-X800 XDR 800 Gbps InfiniBand, rail-optimized full fat-tree, 2-layer (no core); 1 x 800G XDR per NIC, spine uplinks 2 x 800G shown in Fig 7
compute_fabric.oversubscription: Non-blocking fat-tree implied; not numerically stated

storage_fabric.tech: InfiniBand NDR 400G (MQM9700/9701) or Ethernet RoCE (SN5610/SN5600D); per-node I/O must exceed 80 GBps (per SU for Ethernet wording)
storage_fabric.counts: 8-SU/576-node Table 7: Eth storage: 16 DGX-side leaf + 4 storage-side leaf + 12 spine SN5610; IB storage: 16 DGX-side leaf + 8 storage-side leaf + 8 spine NDR (920-9B210-00FN-0M0)
storage_fabric.ratio: Storage devices 1:1 port:uplink; DGX connections oversubscribed near 4:3

inband.speed: 400G BF3 ports (1152 x 400G transceivers for BF3240 over 576 nodes = 2 storage + 2 inband per node); RA text: 200 Gbps bonded

oob.counts: 8-SU Table 7: 69 x SN2201; 3290 RJ45 Cat6; 138 x 100G DR1

mgmt_plane.ufm: 2 x UFM 3.5 appliances (C-UFM 1/2) on four FNM ports of Q3400 switches; manage IB storage and compute fabric

ambiguities: Second of TWO B300 RAs (see b300.json for Spectrum-X/busbar, 64/SU). Metadata differs: this RA is RA-11339-001 dated 2025-07-23.
Table 3 row for 18 SU lists GPU count 9216 but 1296 nodes x 8 = 10368 (cable count column shows 10368); 9216 stored as printed. Also 4 SU spines = 18 (not 16) in table.
Table 7 compute: '2034' twin-port OSFP transceivers on leaf<->DGX is likely a typo for 2304 (4608 NIC ports / 2 per twin-port); stored as printed.
Table 7 caption calls the DGX B300 'B300-AC' and racks Legrand NVIDPD13; 4 systems/rack at ~56 kW is 'reference'; text cautions to reduce density per data-center capability.
Storage fabric per-node requirement: 'exceed 80 GBps' per node (IB) vs '80 GBps per SU' (Ethernet) - inconsistent wording; Table 5 gives 80 GBps aggregate per SU.
Switch port radix for Q3400-RA not in RA text (leaf must carry 72 down + 72 up at 800G by topology). UFM connects to four FNM ports; no node displacement stated.
Fabric SU dimension 72 (cable/leaf counts follow 8 leaves x 72 links) with 18 DGX racks per SU vs DC guide 'up to 72 (XDR) or 64 (Spectrum-X)' - consistent.
GPU memory: RA 2.1 TB vs user guide 2.3 TB (2304 GB used). Inband 200 Gbps bonded in text vs 400G BF3 ports in user guide.
Cooling: AC version is air-cooled; 'cooling' set 'air'. weight 168 kg is PSU variant system weight. max_power 14.5 kW (UG); peak 19.7 kW (DC guide).
Rack power ~56 kW from RA (AC, 4 systems/rack) whereas DC guide only gives 2/rack AC rack (30 kW avg, 39.4 kW peak); 4/rack AC at 56 kW implies 3 rPDUs, not stated in DC guide.
